accessibility.focus: 2px black portfolio focus; original dark-orange WMS inner focus; 44px action targets
accessibility.reducedMotion: Skip type entrances and trail; show text immediately, remove kinetic clipping, clear transforms. WMS is always static.
accessibility.previewScrolling: Native keyboard-operable disclosure around labeled focusable horizontal and vertical scroll regions. Inactive application labels remain noninteractive; scrollbars hidden without disabling scrolling.
accessibility.staticFallback: Factual name, role, WMS summary and contact links are present in index.html before React starts; usable with JavaScript disabled.

extensions.previewNotes: Tonal ramps are generated display aids, not additional implementation tokens. Component HTML is illustrative and does not implement React behavior or downloads.

wms.presentation: Static source-based recreation with all 8 sidebar sections and 27 submenu entries expanded
wms.font: Self-hosted Plus Jakarta Sans, alias WMS Jakarta; 11px compact source dimensions, scoped to preview
wms.responsive: 1100px minimum source composition inside a native horizontal viewport. Bounded shell: homepage 560px, case study 640px, mobile 560px. Separate sidebar/dashboard vertical scrolling. Native outer disclosure defaults open on desktop homepage, closed on mobile and case study.
wms.data: Fictional, visibly labeled dummy data; no backend connection
wms.interaction: WMS has no click actions, tooltips, forms, listeners or chart animation. The external ProjectPreview disclosure can open/close; homepage listens for the 768px breakpoint.
wms.differences: Expanded groups; all permission/feature-gated labels shown; Sales Order presentation at dashboard end; fictional identity/dates/records; small dark-orange contrast adjustments
wms.verificationBoundary: Source templates/CSS inspected; no authenticated live WMS render or pixel-diff comparison. Implementation checks recorded in src/components/wms/README.md.
wms.paletteBoundary: Explicit user exception: preserve the displayed dashboard original orange/indigo/green/red palette. No monochrome filter or recoloring.

scrollTrail.mobile: 1px top progress at 0.6 opacity; no follow-through
scrollTrail.lifecycle: Single on-demand RAF loop; cancels hidden, settled, unmounted; ResizeObserver and pageshow handle geometry/restoration
scrollTrail.appearance: Near-black head/followers on white; 320px rail at 0.06 opacity; 4px head shadow at 0.12 opacity; head rests at 0.2 opacity

layout.hero: Two-line name on left, existing statement and actions on right; stacks below 900px; normal flow on phones.

narrative.overview: White editorial developer portfolio with black typography and a brief kinetic name entrance. The original-color WMS dashboard is the deliberate exception to monochrome; project evidence and readable prose remain the focus.
principles: Averil Primayuda is the signature typographic focal point
White, black and neutral gray surround the project; preserve the displayed WMS colors
A short authored entrance; content visible by default, still, and readable afterward
Reuse Manrope, GSAP, native scroll and existing project schema without dependencies
Keep fictional data labeled, application controls inactive and source boundaries explicit
Use one semantic heading per role; never split every letter or delay access
